Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Record Class ChestObstruction

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component.ChestObstruction
Record Components:
obstructionRule - [optional] How the block should be evaluated by a chest during chest opening. Must be one of the following options: "always" - Will always oba chest from opening when directly above it. "never" - Will never obstruct a chest from opening when directly above it. "shape" - Will use the Blocks collision shape to determine if the chest is obstructed from opening when directly above it; this is the default value if no rule is provided. A Block can define its collision shape by adding a collision component. Add-on JSON obstruction_rule. Default: "shape".
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent
@BedrockFormat("1.26.10") @BedrockExperiment("upcoming_creator_features") @ServerOnly public record ChestObstruction(@NonNull ChestObstruction.ObstructionRule obstructionRule) extends Record implements BlockComponent
This defines how a block reacts to a chest being opened underneath it.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:chest_obstruction". Server only: BDS accepts it in packs but sends nothing to clients (BDS 1.26.36.1, 1.26.45.1, 1.26.52.3, 1.26.63.1, 1.26.70.24), so it has no client effect. Palettes leave it out without a warning. The creator docs name the experiment Upcoming Creator Features for it (in some format versions); unverified against BDS.

Since:
1.0.0
